file_impact.reason: Parameterize _with_connection_retry with attempts/backoffs so the executor can select a one-attempt/no-sleep policy; legacy default byte-for-byte unchanged.

New DC summary executor module: dedicated max_retries=0 client, GET/PUT/GET write with authoritative read-back inspection, ambiguous-PUT observation, and the redacted completion log (transport/_issues/backend are at the LOC cap, so the executor lives in a dedicated module).

Held-out oracle pinning the DC executor contract: max_retries=0 guard + empty-PAT fail-closed, GET/PUT/GET cardinality and read-back inspection, transient/permanent classification, decide_replay mapping, and completion-log bounds.
